description:
You are logged into wger fitness manager at http://localhost as admin (username: admin, password: adminadmin). You are a clinical exercise physiologist running a Phase II cardiac rehabilitation program at a hospital outpatient clinic.

Your patient has recently completed inpatient Phase I recovery following a myocardial infarction (heart attack) and is now cleared for supervised outpatient exercise. A detailed patient program specification has been placed at /home/ga/Documents/cardiac_rehab_protocol.txt.

Read the document carefully and complete ALL of the following in wger:
1. Log the patient's 6-week body weight history (recorded during Phase I hospitalization)
2. Create the 3 clinical measurement categories specified and log their historical assessment data
3. Build the Phase II Cardiac Rehabilitation exercise routine with the specified training days, day-of-week schedules, and exercises
4. Create the heart-healthy nutrition plan with the specified daily nutritional targets

All entries, category names, units, values, day assignments, and nutrition goals must exactly match the specification document.

metadata.expected_routine_description: Supervised outpatient cardiac rehab: 12-week progressive aerobic and resistance program
